placements.why: The Pallasine checklist and its onboarding mechanics are an internal organizational-process matter — no existing strata category covers people/process structure, and this is the seed instance for that tier.
placements.title: Organization
placements.frame: What structures, processes, and roles constitute how the company organizes and onboards its people?

placements.title: Onboarding is standardized into a repeatable, evolving checklist rather than ad hoc orientation
placements.frame: What gets added, dropped, or reordered in the checklist's required steps (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) as the process is revised over time?
placements.why: Both segments describe the same enduring onboarding artifact — its current required steps and its supersession of a prior version — naming a subject (the checklist as institutional process) that future envelopes will keep feeding as it changes, not a one-time fact.
